compiler_trace_diagnostic.method: Same CFLAGS/LDFLAGS and TU bytes, fresh temporary source paths, observation-only -ftime-trace; concurrent ExecuteCompiler wall-interval union. linkDriver is residual driver/link/trace emission, NOT isolated linker CPU. wasmOpt is absent. Execution is one reset/run per mode, NOT the full RC/permission matrix. All output wasm byte sizes match original; this diagnostic is not a correctness oracle.

transient_diagnostics.split-probe: rejected: separate -c/link changes wasm size, not used for timing evidence
transient_diagnostics.trace-cases: rejected: cached libc produces no fresh compiler trace; corrected by unique source paths without changing contents
